execution_boundary: Completed receipts predate the active AX reuse/streaming/Windows capability/notice-inventory source wave. They do not verify that wave, the current whole tree, a release build, or binary/source identity beyond the explicitly recorded fields.

raw_report.navigation: Private raw artifact retained by owner; absolute profile/model/tool paths intentionally omitted.

process_exit.source: Parent completed-run receipt; raw JSON itself has no process-exit field.

compact_evicted_history.interpretation: Reuse of evicted history is intentionally refused, then all 128 target tokens are cold-recomputed. This is not a checkpoint-adoption result.

summary.scope: Updated original synthetic cache smoke, not the separate 55-case corpus, full64 quality, universal batch invariance or whole-memory checkpoint adoption.

related_identity.binding_limit: Identity recorded by the separate ordinary-cache schedule receipt. The saved-policy and live-reuse raw reports do not independently record model-file or executed-binary hashes; this related identity is not a new execution attestation.

measurement_policy: All non-timing raw fields retained below, including failed cross-batch diagnostics and historical evidence references. Elapsed *_us/*_ms fields omitted. No speed/power/default-change claim.
